name: Cuttle
summary: Two-player combat card game where you build point cards to 21 while scuttling, stealing and destroying opponent's cards.
rules_text: Two players share a standard 52-card deck. Deal 6 cards to dealer and 5 to opponent, rest is draw pile; scrap pile is face-up discard showing top only. On your turn do exactly one: draw one card, or play one card from hand. Number cards A,2-10 can be point cards worth their value (A=1) placed on your side; first to 21+ points wins, but kings reduce requirement to 14/10/7/5 for 1-4 kings you control. A point card can also scuttle: play a higher rank, or equal rank with higher suit C<D<H<S, to discard both cards. Cards  A,2-7,9 can be one-offs discarded after use for effects like wipe points, destroy permanents, recover from scrap, force opponent discard 2, draw 2, play top of deck immediately, bounce a permanent. 8,J,Q,K are permanents staying on table: 8 forces opponent to reveal hand, J stacked on a point card steals it, Q protects your other points/permanents from single-target effects, K lowers win threshold. 2 can be played on opponent's turn to counter a one-off. If draw pile empty you may pass; three passes ends game with no winner.
